changelog: Updates prune their old backups. Each update copies the whole install, .env included, to /opt/urbackup-gui-backup-<timestamp> and never removed one. After a successful update the three newest are now kept and older ones deleted. A failure while pruning is logged and cannot roll back the update.
Pruning is done by the update script, and an update runs the previously installed one, so it starts with the update after this one.
